# 获取机器人切换配置

## OpenAPI Specification

```yaml
openapi: 3.0.1
info:
  title: ''
  description: ''
  version: 1.0.0
paths:
  /openapi/robot/transfer/config:
    post:
      summary: 获取机器人切换配置
      deprecated: false
      description: |-
        **简要描述：**

        - 通过接口指定机器人id，获取管理端机器人转接中配置的切换信息，禁用状态的机器人不再返回。若固定入口开关处于关闭状态，将返回空值。

        **频率限制：**

        - 1次/秒
      tags:
        - 机器人/消息接口
      parameters: []
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              properties:
                robotId:
                  type: string
                  description: 机器人id
              required:
                - robotId
      responses:
        '200':
          description: ''
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  code:
                    type: integer
                  message:
                    type: string
                  data:
                    type: object
                    properties:
                      entranceTips:
                        type: string
                        description: 切换机器人引导短语
                      entranceGuide:
                        type: string
                        description: 切换机器人引导语
                      transferList:
                        type: array
                        items:
                          type: object
                          properties:
                            robotId:
                              type: integer
                              description: 机器人id
                            robotName:
                              type: string
                              description: 机器人对外名称
                            realName:
                              type: string
                              description: 机器人对内名称
                            biz_name:
                              type: string
                              description: 对外展示业务名称
                            group_id:
                              type: integer
                              description: '转人工分流组id #'
                            portraitUrl:
                              type: string
                              description: 机器人头像
                          required:
                            - robotId
                            - robotName
                            - realName
                            - biz_name
                            - group_id
                            - portraitUrl
                    required:
                      - entranceTips
                      - entranceGuide
                required:
                  - code
                  - message
                  - data
              example: "{\n  \"code\": 200,\n  \"message\": \"哈哈\",\n  \"data\": {\n    \"entranceTips\": \"切换业务\",\n    \"entranceGuide\": \"请选择要咨询的业务\",\n    \"transferList\": [\n      {\n        \"robotId\": 10000,\n        \"robotName\": \"小七\",\n        \"realName\": \"小七\",\n\t\t\"biz_name\":\"手机业务\",//对外展示业务名称\n        \"group_id\":131323,    //转人工分流组\n        \"portraitUrl\": \"https://ysf.qiyukf.net/operation/49f100747e5fd65876961f9225516ebb\"\n      }\n    ]\n  }\n}"
          headers: {}
          x-apifox-name: 成功
      security: []
      x-apifox-folder: 机器人/消息接口
      x-apifox-status: released
      x-run-in-apifox: https://app.apifox.com/web/project/605287/apis/api-10845543-run
components:
  schemas: {}
  securitySchemes: {}
servers:
  - url: http://qiyukf.com
    description: 正式环境
security: []

```
